Name of donor: Embassy of Israel
Address of donor: Embassy of Israel, 2 Palace Green, London W8 4QB
Estimate of the probable value (or amount of any donation): Flights (£800),  food and transport (£1760), accommodation (£1250), value £3,810
Destination of visit: Israel
Dates of visit: 23 October 2025 to 30 October 2025
Purpose of visit: This was a fact finding visit which included visiting Israeli Jews, Christians, Muslims, Druze and others, meeting members of civil and political society (including Government and opposition MK's) being briefed by eyewitnesses to the murderous terrorist attacks by Hamas, Hezbollah, Iran and the Houthis.
(Registered 12 November 2025)

Board Member of the Centre for Brexit Policy. This is an unpaid role.
Date interest arose: 1 June 2019
